attachments.origin_landmark: maxilla above the incisor and canine teeth
attachments.insertion_landmark: nasal cartilage and the aponeurosis over the bridge of the nose

functional_compartments.name: Transverse part (compressor naris)
functional_compartments.function_note: Compresses the nasal aperture across the bridge.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Alar part (dilator naris)
functional_compartments.function_note: Draws the ala laterally and downwards, widening the nostril. Visible nasal flaring in respiratory distress is this part recruited as an accessory muscle of respiration.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse, over the area between the medial canthus and the nasal dorsum -- the region where 'bunny line' wrinkles appear on nose-scrunching.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: This area is bordered by four muscles -- procerus, nasalis, orbicularis oculi and levator labii superioris alaeque nasi -- which do not meet edge-to-edge: a consistent non-muscular gap (the 'bunny triangle') separates them, sized and shaped according to the width of the procerus and nasalis. Conventional BoNT injection placed directly into the visible bunny-line wrinkle is therefore likely to land in this connective-tissue gap rather than in muscle.
structures_at_risk: orbicularis oculi and levator labii superioris alaeque nasi, bordering nasalis at this junction -- over-injection laterally/superiorly risks eyelid or lip-elevator weakness
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Based on ultrasonography in 13 volunteers and dissection of 39 cadavers. The authors recommend targeting BoNT-A at the borders of procerus, nasalis, orbicularis oculi and levator labii superioris alaeque nasi -- not at the wrinkle itself -- for more reliable bunny-line treatment.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Ahn H, Hu H, Kim SB, Lee JH, Choi YJ, Hu KS, Shah-Desai S, Abe S, Kim HJ, Clin Anat 38(6):686-691 (2024), doi:10.1002/ca.24249 (https://doi.org/10.1002/ca.24249) -- retrieved via PubMed
